definitions.gloss: major company, leading firm, large corporation
definitions.explanation: A large, well-established company that is a leader in its industry. Used as both a noun and as a modifier before other nouns.

definitions.gloss: main gate, front gate (of a castle)
definitions.explanation: The main entrance of a castle or fortress. A historical/architectural term.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To get a job at a major company.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: A major manufacturer announced a new product.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦チェーン→チェーン：08833_cheen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出店|しゅってん}→出店：12045_shutten⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商店|しょうてん}→商店：11841_shouten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦戦|くせん}→苦戦：13990_kusen⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Local shops are struggling because a major convenience store chain opened a branch.
To pass through the castle's main gate.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}{門|もん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堀|ほり}→堀：03725_hori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}らされていた→巡らす：12414_megurasu⟧。
examples.english: A moat was built around the front of the main gate.

examples.japanese: {大手|おおて}{門|もん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{天守閣|てんしゅかく}→天守閣：17449_tenshukaku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いて→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{見学|けんがく}→見学：00214_kengaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We walked from the main gate to the castle keep on the tour.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is far more common in modern usage. {大手|おおて} is often used as a modifier: {大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう} (major company), {大手|おおて}⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧ (major bank), {大手|おおて}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧ (major manufacturer). It can also stand alone as a noun meaning "a major player/company."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大手|おおて}{企業|きぎょう}: major company
- {大手|おおて}⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧: major bank
- {大手|おおて}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: major manufacturer
- {大手|おおて}{門|もん}: castle main gate (sense 2)
